verdict.rationale: Navan's core booking product shows in-platform flight/hotel booking with policy limits enforced at search time ('price to beat' under policy, docs-12/27), self-serve booking with 24/7 support (docs-11), human travel agents that must confirm before booking (docs-14-16), and unlimited configurable policy/approval workflows applied to travel (docs-25) plus connected corporate cards for direct billing (docs-9) rather than post-hoc expensing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that out-of-policy bookings are actually blocked or flagged in real time (only vendor marketing/docs cited), and no detail on how policy violations are handled during the booking flow itself.
